title.narrative: Rider 005 - AV4 - extension periodo implementacion hasta 136 meses (08/10/2028)

description.narrative: The project consists in the construction of a 50 MW photovoltaic power plant and its connection to the national grid. The power plant will be located in the highlands of the western part of Bolivia, in the Altiplano region, 45km from Oruro city in the municipality of Caracollo. With the favorable sun radiation conditions of this area, the plant is expected to generate approximately 94,500 GWh/year (P90 assumption). The plant will be connected to the national grid through an existing 115 kV transmission line and the electricity will be sold in the Bolivian electricity wholesale market.

description.narrative: SDG 13 Climate ActionFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: Considering 100 000 TeqCO2 per year and 25 year lifespan

The value was changed from 164124 tonnes to 100000 tonnes during Quality Control. 1. This is an EURF indicator and the methodology specifies that the value to report is an annual value not the total value as done. 2. This is an EURF indicator and the methodology note requires reporting the expected result i.e. the target as the current value 100000 tonnes. The final target must also be revised to 100000 tonnes. If this is not done this will have a negative effect on the score for EAMR KPI 10.
